ensemble_convention.label: Median of complete union-wide NPP model totals
ensemble_convention.formula: median(NPP_model(fixed union)) over every model scheduled for that year
ensemble_convention.note: Models are integrated over one dissolved polygon union, scaled to its gap-filled Antoine–Morel baseline using the existing NPP common-mask ratio method. This is not the sum of regional medians. All scheduled models must have finite union totals.
